scope: one human, one test guild, one active voice channel; local CPU models only

checks.name: Discord Gateway login and guild slash-command registration
checks.evidence: actual dedicated-bot connection via application route

checks.name: Normal Discord OAuth identity sign-in
checks.evidence: browser returned to authenticated non-operator panel after correcting callback and client credential

checks.name: DAVE voice-room join and actual receive/decode
checks.evidence: bot joined via slash command; live speech produced captions in the authenticated panel

checks.name: Turkish to English synthesized playback
checks.evidence: tester explicitly confirmed hearing English output

checks.name: English to Turkish captions and synthesized playback
checks.evidence: tester explicitly confirmed Turkish captions and audio; preferences were subsequently changed, so that output was not independently retained

checks.name: Revoke local consent
checks.evidence: agent observed consent off and previous captions cleared; tester confirmed no new output when speaking

checks.name: Leave voice room
checks.evidence: tester left; agent observed no accessible room, no participants and disabled room controls

notTested: multiple human participants or simultaneous target languages
live role-removal and cross-guild denial with another real account
general translation quality, stress tests or p95 latency
privacy: No credentials, human utterance text, raw human audio or identifying guild/user IDs are included in this report.
